extDescription.message: Open the current page in Chrome's split view with the original on the left and a translation on the right. Scrolling and navigation stay in sync. Translation runs on your device.

actionTitle.message: Show original and translation side by side

actionTitleActive.message: Split Translate: syncing with the other tab. Click to close the translated tab

actionTitlePaused.message: Split Translate: paused while Chrome's page translation is on. Click to close the translated tab

optionsOnDeviceHint.message: Translation uses Chrome's built-in Translator API and runs on your device. Page content is never sent to an external server.

optionsPrepareModelHint.message: Each language pair needs a one-time model download. Downloading it here lets translation start right away when you open a split view.

optionsAllSitesHint.message: When off, you are asked for permission the first time you use the extension on each site. When on, it works on any site without asking.

optionsSyncNavigation.message: Sync navigation (when one side opens another page, the other side follows)

statusSameLanguage.message: The original and target languages must be different.

statusNoTranslator.message: The Translator API is not available in this version of Chrome.

statusPairUnsupported.message: This language pair is not supported.

bannerNoTranslator.message: The Translator API is not available in this version of Chrome.

bannerPairUnsupported.message: Translation from $SOURCE$ to $TARGET$ is not supported.

bannerPausedForChrome.message: Paused while Chrome's page translation is on
